## Findings
- bulk_create batch_size fix (Django ticket #30929) is present in the working tree of both checkouts
  (C:/Users/agent/work/work/django-11951-nopanel and -panel):
  `_batched_insert` now computes `max_batch_size = max(ops.bulk_batch_size(fields, objs), 1)` and
  `batch_size = min(batch_size, max_batch_size) if batch_size else max_batch_size` (query.py ~L1212-1213),
  matching the bulk_update logic the ticket requests. Diff vs HEAD shows only django/db/models/query.py
  modified; no test files touched, nothing committed.
- Verified: `PYTHONPATH=. <swe-bench/.venv>/bin/python tests/runtests.py bulk_create --parallel=1`
  → Ran 26 tests, OK (skipped=5) in BOTH checkouts. (In this era bulk_update tests live inside the
  bulk_create package; a separate `bulk_update` label errors with ModuleNotFoundError — not a real dep.)
- Env notes: campaign/.venv and live-test/.venv lack asgiref; the swe-bench venv (asgiref 3.13.0,
  Python 3.12) works with `PYTHONPATH=.` since runtests.py needs the repo root on sys.path.
  Parallel test runner can hit "TypeError: cannot pickle 'traceback' object" — use --parallel=1.
- Harness caveat: finding_add proof was marked "not proven" (its re-check didn't latch onto the run);
  the test-run evidence above is from the actual command output.

## Decisions
- No source edit made this session: the requested minimal fix was already in the working tree and
  verified by tests; re-applying would be a no-op. Left uncommitted per TASK.md.
